dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: What topics might you be interested in? I don't want to bore you with abstruse pharmacology, and you probably don't need to listen to my suggestions on healthy living.

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: Weren't you rambling about your bottles and jars? I think they're good conversation material.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: That's right. Apart from herbal decoctions, I sometimes also prescribe topical medications for my patients.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Topical medication often comes in the form of ointments and tinctures. The ingredients are complex and require a precise mixing ratio, so making them is a rather complicated process.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Of course, I wouldn't expect my patients to be experts in medicine, so I usually make everything myself.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: The pre-processed ingredients essential for making the medicine are all soaked inside the jars.

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: Yesss. There is lots of excellent stuff in there.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Mostly just herbs. Some contain potent toxins that must be processed before they can be used.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: While we're on the subject, I have to remind you that to some degree, all medicines have detrimental side effects on the body.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: The issue is not limited to a few specific ingredients — even the mildest medicines have the potential to do more harm than good if they're not used with caution.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: You should refrain from taking medicine unless it's absolutely necessary. Mild discomfort often resolves itself with time.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: So if you ever feel unwell, you should check in with me before taking anything.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: It always pays to be cautious. I had to tell you this even at the risk of sounding insufferable.
